mapper.select: SELECT p.user_financial_profile_id AS userFinancialProfileId, p.user_id AS userId, u.login_email AS loginEmail, u.user_name AS userName, p.annual_income AS annualIncome, p.income_type AS incomeType, p.employment_status AS employmentStatus, p.credit_score AS creditScore, p.liquid_asset_amount AS liquidAssetAmount FROM app_user u INNER JOIN user_financial_profile p ON p.user_id = u.user_id WHERE u.login_email = #{loginEmail} LIMIT 1
SELECT DISTINCT rate_type_code AS code, rate_type_name AS name FROM housing_loan_product_option WHERE NULLIF(TRIM(rate_type_code), '') IS NOT NULL ORDER BY rate_type_code, rate_type_name

SELECT DISTINCT repayment_type_code AS code, repayment_type_name AS name FROM housing_loan_product_option WHERE NULLIF(TRIM(repayment_type_code), '') IS NOT NULL ORDER BY repayment_type_code, repayment_type_name

SELECT DISTINCT collateral_type_code AS code, collateral_type_name AS name FROM housing_loan_product_option WHERE NULLIF(TRIM(collateral_type_code), '') IS NOT NULL ORDER BY collateral_type_code, collateral_type_name

SELECT d.credit_product_type_name AS creditProductTypeName, c.catalog_product_id AS catalogProductId, c.product_name AS productName, c.loan_type AS loanType, c.min_rate AS catalogMinRate, c.max_rate AS catalogMaxRate, c.max_limit_amount AS maxLimitAmount, c.max_period_months AS maxPeriodMonths, c.target_description AS targetDescription, c.institution_name AS institutionName, c.join_way AS joinWay, o.credit_loan_rate_option_id AS creditLoanRateOptionId, o.rate_category_code AS rateCategoryCode, o.rate_category_name AS rateCategoryName, o.rate_over_900 AS rateOver900, o.rate_801_900 AS rate801To900, o.rate_701_800 AS rate701To800, o.rate_601_700 AS rate601To700, o.rate_501_600 AS rate501To600, o.rate_401_500 AS rate401To500, o.rate_301_400 AS rate301To400, o.rate_300_or_below AS rate300OrBelow, o.average_rate AS averageRate
FROM loan_product_catalog c
INNER JOIN credit_loan_product_detail d ON d.catalog_product_id = c.catalog_product_id
INNER JOIN credit_loan_rate_option o ON o.catalog_product_id = c.catalog_product_id WHERE c.active = TRUE AND c.loan_type = 'CREDIT' AND o.rate_category_code = 'A' ORDER BY c.catalog_product_id, o.credit_loan_rate_option_id

SELECT c.catalog_product_id AS catalogProductId, c.product_name AS productName, c.loan_type AS loanType, c.min_rate AS catalogMinRate, c.max_rate AS catalogMaxRate, c.max_limit_amount AS maxLimitAmount, c.max_period_months AS maxPeriodMonths, c.target_description AS targetDescription, c.institution_name AS institutionName, c.join_way AS joinWay, o.housing_loan_product_option_id AS housingLoanProductOptionId, o.collateral_type_code AS collateralTypeCode, o.collateral_type_name AS collateralTypeName, o.repayment_type_code AS repaymentTypeCode, o.repayment_type_name AS repaymentTypeName, o.rate_type_code AS rateTypeCode, o.rate_type_name AS rateTypeName, o.min_rate AS optionMinRate, o.max_rate AS optionMaxRate, o.average_rate AS optionAverageRate, d.loan_limit_text AS loanLimitText FROM loan_product_catalog c INNER JOIN housing_loan_product_option o ON o.catalog_product_id = c.catalog_product_id LEFT JOIN housing_loan_product_detail d ON d.catalog_product_id = c.catalog_product_id WHERE c.active = TRUE AND c.loan_type = #{loanType} ORDER BY c.catalog_product_id, o.collateral_type_code, o.repayment_type_code, o.rate_type_code, o.housing_loan_product_option_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO loan_product ( catalog_product_id, product_name, loan_type, min_rate, max_rate, max_limit_amount, max_period_months, target_description, active, institution_name, user_financial_profile_id, recommendation_rank, recommended_rate, loan_purpose, requested_amount, requested_term_months, calculation_method, estimated_monthly_payment, estimated_total_interest, estimated_total_cost ) VALUES ( #{catalogProductId}, #{productName}, #{loanType}, #{minRate}, #{maxRate}, #{maxLimitAmount}, #{maxPeriodMonths}, #{targetDescription}, TRUE, #{institutionName}, #{userFinancialProfileId}, #{recommendationRank}, #{recommendedRate}, #{loanPurpose}, #{requestedAmount}, #{requestedTermMonths}, #{calculationMethod}, #{estimatedMonthlyPayment}, #{estimatedTotalInterest}, #{estimatedTotalCost} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE product_name = VALUES(product_name), loan_type = VALUES(loan_type), min_rate = VALUES(min_rate), max_rate = VALUES(max_rate), max_limit_amount = VALUES(max_limit_amount), max_period_months = VALUES(max_period_months), target_description = VALUES(target_description), active = TRUE, institution_name = VALUES(institution_name), recommendation_rank = VALUES(recommendation_rank), recommended_rate = VALUES(recommended_rate), loan_purpose = VALUES(loan_purpose), requested_amount = VALUES(requested_amount), requested_term_months = VALUES(requested_term_months), calculation_method = VALUES(calculation_method), estimated_monthly_payment = VALUES(estimated_monthly_payment), estimated_total_interest = VALUES(estimated_total_interest), estimated_total_cost = VALUES(estimated_total_cost), updated_at = NOW()
